mathematical_scope.K: Nonzero iff a cyclic element avoids all kernels; induced and customary KU orientations differ by a universally formed unit pulled back from CP infinity.
mathematical_scope.W: Dimension p+1 over C_(p^2) x C_p; ordinary integral/K Euler and all proper-subgroup restrictions vanish; MSTOP Euler value uncomputed.
mathematical_scope.formal: Exact Euler expression and relations only; formal quotient is not asserted to present MSTOP cohomology, nor to inject or surject.
mathematical_scope.ordinary: Nonzero mod-p image iff every character lies outside pG*; not an iff criterion for MSTOP.
mathematical_scope.sources: Inspected arXiv v1; published/preprint equivalence and independent tom Dieck proof audit not claimed.
mathematical_scope.splitting: Exotic-map spectrum splitting and coefficient isomorphism modulo torsion do not supply a detector compatible with natural complex orientation.
mathematical_scope.sufficient: Dimension <= p or reciprocal-order sum <= 1; zero representation has unit Euler class.
mathematical_scope.target: Canonical MU -> MSO -> MSTOP -> MSTOP_(p), Borel Euler classes; odd p and finite abelian p-groups.
mathematical_scope.universal: Universal assertion equivalent to nonnilpotence, not merely nonzero, of full Euler product.
